ORDINANCE FER Iu, 2024
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION |. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is hereby amended by changing all of the RS3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached
House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 20-E in the area

bounded by

A line 253.61 feet north of and parallel to East 80" Street; south Calumet Avenue; a line
223.61 feet north of and parallel to East 80" Street; and the alley next west of and

parallel to South Calumet Avenue
to those of a RT 3.5, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.
SECTION2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 7936 S. Calumet Avenue, Chicago, Illinois 60619
